integrity: The statements distinguish established greedy-arch theory from the new composition-refined enumeration and type-class consequences; no external independent review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive checks corroborate but do not replace the proof. The fixed-composition limit requires every limiting alphabet frequency to be positive, and no variance or central limit theorem is established. Published equivalent formulations cannot be excluded.
title: Composition-refined enumeration and type laws for subsequence universality
